machineCredential.description: 独立机器管理凭据，仅可调用显式支持的项目 API。与来源采集凭据分开，不可与会话 Cookie 混用。

allowed_origins.description: 精确 http(s) origin，包括必要端口，不接受通配符、路径、查询参数或凭据。

application_state.description: 当前接收器通过共享数据库读取配置，凭据缓存最长 2 秒。变更提交后，首次读取观察到该版本才开始计时；等待缓存失效窗口后 applied。它表示旧缓存已过期，不代表每个节点逐一确认；依赖不可用时接收器关闭接入。

allowed_origins.description: 精确 http(s) origin，包括必要端口，不接受通配符、路径、查询参数或凭据。

schema.description: 受限的扁平属性定义：最多50个字段，仅字符串、有限安全数值、布尔值和最多20项的同类型标量数组。必须显式禁止额外属性；不支持远程引用、嵌套对象、正则和组合规则。详细限制与发布完整性由事件校验服务验证。

DraftInput.description: schema 必须提交并整体替换；省略可选元数据保留旧值，显式空对象或数组表示清空。空字符串与省略不同。发布时必须补全触发条件、来源类型、事实类型并通过样例验证。

expected_active_revision.description: 比较实际已激活版本，不是最近构建版本。通过激活查询读取；尚未激活时为 0。

state.description: published 表示不可变定义已构建并持久保存；是否可以接收事件必须单独检查 ingestion_ready。

active_release_revision.description: 当前已激活版本；尚未激活时为 0。

allowed_origins.description: 精确 http(s) origin，包括必要端口，不接受通配符、路径、查询参数或凭据。

server_secret_once.description: 仅服务端来源创建或轮换时返回一次；不允许进入列表或日志

application_state.description: 当前接收器通过共享数据库读取配置，凭据缓存最长 2 秒。变更提交后，首次读取观察到该版本才开始计时；等待缓存失效窗口后 applied。它表示旧缓存已过期，不代表每个节点逐一确认；依赖不可用时接收器关闭接入。

allowed_origins.description: 精确 http(s) origin，包括必要端口，不接受通配符、路径、查询参数或凭据。

schema.description: 仅保留客户端校验所需关键词，移除示例、描述、默认值及内部元数据。

events.description: 只包含当前来源类型可上报的事件；允许为空。

approximate_aggregations.description: Only unique and p95 accept explicit approximate accuracy; all aggregations default to exact.

AnalysisCatalogField.description: Property operators use the existing engine: is_present tests key existence, including explicit null; is_missing tests absent keys within the referenced event/version. Typed comparisons exclude null and absent values. Nullable schema unions and unsupported nested/object fields are omitted.

AnalysisCatalogEvent.description: Read-only immutable version metadata published in this environment. active means included in the current default active release; ingestion_ready additionally requires that active release to have a current verified readiness lease. Neither flag proves source eligibility or query capacity. fields includes only supported top-level typed properties.

MetricDependency.description: Immutable pin to the metric version backing a metric-referencing saved analysis.

QueryValidation.description: Read-only dry validation; no query job, scan or result is created. execution_available reports runtime configuration, not proven capacity or execution success. Unfixed event_keys/all_events remain unfixed; only manifest event_versions are immutable dependencies. Execution reauthorizes and revalidates.

MetricReference.description: Immutable pointer to a published metric version. The exact version is pinned at publication and never resolves to the latest metric.

FormulaExpression.description: Restricted typed formula node. constant carries only value, metric carries only an immutable reference, and add/subtract/multiply/divide carry only left and right children. There is no string grammar, SQL or JavaScript. Tree depth is at most 8, nodes at most 64 and distinct references at most 8.

FormulaDefinition.description: Composite formula and its declared result unit, which must match the unit derived from the operands. Unit labels never convert values.

FormulaMetricDefinition.description: Composite metric definition. It carries no direct event selection or aggregation; every operand is a pinned immutable atomic metric version. Maximum 131072 UTF-8 JSON bytes.

FormulaMetricValidation.description: Read-only semantic validation of a composite formula metric. No query execution, mutation or audit write occurs. The dependency graph and units are resolved inside the authorizing storage transaction before the validation digests are derived.

SavedAnalysisDefinition.description: Stored/read model. At most 131072 UTF-8 encoded JSON bytes. A metric-referencing analysis carries both the metric_ref pin and the query derived from the pinned metric; inline analyses carry only the query. Visualization compatibility is validated without executing the query.

SavedAnalysisDefinitionInput.description: Write model for create and update. Exactly one data source is allowed: an inline query or a metric_ref that pins an immutable metric version. A metric reference requires the metric visualization and omits the query; the server derives and returns the query.

SavedAnalysisValidation.description: Read-only semantic validation. No query execution, mutation or audit write occurs. The validation hash binds the resource scope, draft/publication counters, normalized definition, dependencies and bounded diff; publication reauthorizes and recomputes it transactionally.

SavedAnalysisExecute.description: Binds caller-supplied time_range and timezone to the immutable published configuration and its stored environment.

DashboardDefinition.description: At most 65536 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Stable widget UUIDs, unique contiguous reading_order starting at zero, nonoverlapping integer layout within 12 columns and 1000 rows. Each widget pins an immutable saved-analysis version in this project/environment. Definitions contain configuration only.

DashboardValidation.description: Read-only semantic validation. No query execution, mutation or audit write occurs. The validation hash binds the resource scope, draft/publication counters, normalized definition, dependencies and bounded diff; publication reauthorizes and recomputes it transactionally.

DashboardExecute.description: Bind required global time/timezone to every pinned analysis. Optional runtime widget_filters explicitly target distinct existing widget IDs and are ANDed with immutable fixed filters. Existing query field/type/version and resource budgets apply. All child jobs are admitted atomically or no run is created. Same-key retries return the original run; changed input conflicts, expired runs require a new key.

DashboardRun.description: Per-widget query jobs and existing authorized result URLs. No result copies or shared child queries. Current project authorization is checked on each read/cancel/result request. Terminal outcomes with both successful and unsuccessful widgets are partial; runs without successful widgets are failed unless all children are canceled or all are expired; expiration follows child result lifetimes. Coverage remains provisional and widgets do not share an atomic data snapshot. Runtime bounds retain nanosecond precision, timezone and normalized targeted filters exactly; timestamp storage projections do not replace the execution input.

MetricValidation.description: Read-only semantic validation. No query execution, mutation or audit write occurs. The validation hash binds the resource scope, draft/publication counters, normalized definition, dependencies and bounded diff; publication reauthorizes and recomputes it transactionally.

MetricExecute.description: Binds a published metric to its stored environment and an explicit range of at most 31 days. Runtime filter is AND-combined with its fixed filter. Unit annotations perform no conversion. Omit interval for a whole-window aggregate; daily unique values must never be summed to derive whole-window unique.

MetricDefinition.description: Independent atomic metric; maximum 131072 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Pinned immutable event versions, fixed filter and aggregation define its semantics. Unit annotates the result and performs no conversion. Count requires event; unique without field uses raw_uid for uid or anonymous_id for anonymous; unique with field uses distinct_value; numerical aggregations use number, millisecond, second or byte.
